text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has injured herself during
training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ow! How can it hurt this much?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why was I so stupid? I shouldn't
have
pushed myself so hard...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the worst part is, I won't be able to
run for a
while...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I know. Not like I could do much
even if I
wanted to.
choice_data_list: Let's take good care of your body for now.
Once you're healed, we'll make up for it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, enough talk. I'll rest up, so
you can go
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for worrying you. I'm going to get
some
rest, so you can get back to work
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looks miserable as she
fights
against her pain and frustration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Believe me, I'm planning to
make up
for this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll get better little by little and return to
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I barely even moved... Just how
long is this
going to take to heal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober looks beyond devastated
when she
realizes how severe and
persistent her pain is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I need to stay optimistic. This could be
a good
learning experience!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since I can't move at all, can you
give
lectures instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That way, when I'm all recovered, I'll be
better
equipped to make up for lost
time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober makes the most out of her

convalescence, and afterwards seems to
have
discovered something new!
